# ICHITA Membrane Skid — Technical Proposal

**Prepared for** Siam Refinery Co., Ltd. · **Date** 2026-08-06 · **Ref** ICH-2026-0412

## 1. Executive Summary

ICHITA proposes a two-stage nanofiltration skid rated at 2569 m³/day, replacing the
existing carbon-only decolorization train. Measured colour removal is 94.2% at a
specific energy of 0.68 kWh/m³.

The skid is delivered as a single pre-piped module. Site work is limited to feed,
permeate, concentrate and CIP tie-ins.

## 2. Process Conditions

| Parameter | Design | Guaranteed | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Feed flow | 2569 | 2400 | m³/day |
| Colour removal | 94.2 | 92.0 | % |
| Specific energy | 0.68 | 0.75 | kWh/m³ |
| Recovery | 85 | 82 | % |
| Operating pressure | 12.5 | 14.0 | bar |

### 2.1 Feed Water Quality

The feed is clarified juice at 55–60 °Bx. Turbidity must stay below 5 NTU; the
guarantee is void above 8 NTU sustained for more than 30 minutes.

## 3. Scope of Supply

- Two-stage NF skid, 316L wetted parts
- CIP unit with heater and dosing
- Instrumentation and local control panel
- Commissioning and operator training, 5 days

1. Detailed design — 4 weeks
2. Fabrication — 12 weeks
3. FAT — 2 weeks
4. Site installation and commissioning — 3 weeks
